checkpoints: 1, min(cap-1,count), min(cap,count), min(cap+1,count), count-1, count; unique ascending
vector_source: sparse deterministic float32 controls; never real model inference
positive_control: late persisted text/cover, late physically current book pages, literal name/tag and literal pending search
negative_control: metadata ID 2 has no vector; page-only books are unindexed for origin-cover similarity
acceptance: All indexed eligible controls participate independent of ID, with honest counts; every audit control must also pass
baseline_expectation: Current 10k search cap causes completion gate failures; audit_passed alone never means product acceptance
limits: Not dense-pool RRF equivalence, filesystem scan, real quality, RAM, GUI or 1TB evidence
